If the next race confirms sustained zero line loss and reduced steering oscillation, this supports the benefit of moving the front-center sensor forward to y=0.07 m and shifting the outer sensors forward to y=0.05 m. If line loss events or oscillations increase, consider reverting the front-center sensor to y=0.065 m or adjusting lateral sensor positions for better coverage. If progress or completion decreases, consider tuning PID gains or slightly increasing wheel track for enhanced stability.
